audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Quinn levels 3, 6 and the 2-item stage, contradicting the packet levelChart, the entry's own whys[3]-[6] (which describe Akali killing Quinn on those stages) and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Akali, Akali, Akali, Akali; the mirror slice already re-cut Akali's page to exactly that, so leaving Quinn's side unchanged would have the two pages disagree and mirror-fix.js would overwrite it.
audit.corrected: win[2..6] and phases[2..6].side re-cut to Skill, Akali, Akali, Akali, Akali with inverse ratings; the whys already read that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why still framed level 6 as Quinn's roam spike with no numbers.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60 and Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16 — 6 is her swing, not Quinn's.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around her two-part R and the 20s shroud.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named no cooldown and Assassin's Mark never appears anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: her ring-exit empowers her NEXT attack with bonus range — the wind-up is the burst tell, and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable so Vault (which needs a target) cannot even be cast at her.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now carry the 20s shroud, the 16s Shuriken Flip and the untargetable-so-Vault-has-no-target point.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers on the punishable window.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1; that is the poke window.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your range.
edits.after: Coin flip: her shroud is not impactful yet and your blind still cancels her trade, so whoever lands first takes it.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's two dashes plus a 20s Twilight Shroud flip the all-in at 6 — shove and roam instead of dueling her.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on she blanks your Q and E from shroud and executes you — carry threat 8.5/10, so close the game before then.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — untargetable inside, so Vault has no target to leap off. Step up while it is empty. - Shuriken Flip: 16s at rank 1. - Vault: 12s, spacing only. - Behind Enemy Lines: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Vault-blind + R her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud, 20s: she is unselectable inside, so Vault cannot even target her. Poke it out, then Vault-blind + R.

edits.before: The lane has chapters — the chart is the table of contents.
edits.after: Yours through level 2, a coin flip at 3, hers from 4 on.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s cooldown, and she is unselectable inside it — engage only once it is spent.

notes: Chart re-cut to match the packet and the already-published Akali page; the whys on this page already described Akali winning stages 3-6, so only the enum rows were out of step. Assassin's Mark empowers her NEXT attack after she leaves the ring — the wind-up, not the spell cast, is the step-back cue; recorded in the audit but no prose slot took it without pushing a field out of band.
